metaexchangecalendar(caldt, exchangegroup, tradingflg) AS (
    SELECT day::date, groups.name::character varying,
           (CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM day) < 6
                  AND to_char(day, 'MM-DD') NOT IN ('01-01', '12-25')
                 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END)::character varying
    FROM generate_series(DATE '2015-06-01', DATE '2021-12-31', INTERVAL '1 day') AS day,
         (VALUES ('CIZ'), ('NYSE')) AS groups(name)
),
stkdlysecuritydata(
    permno, dlycaldt, dlyprevdt, dlyret, dlyretmissflg, dlyretdurflg,
    dlydelflg, dlyprc, dlyprcflg, dlyvol
) AS (
    SELECT securities.permno, calendar.caldt,
           lag(calendar.caldt) OVER (PARTITION BY securities.permno ORDER BY calendar.caldt),
           round((hashtext(securities.permno::text || calendar.caldt::text) % 2000) / 100000.0, 6),
           'NA'::character varying, 'D1'::character varying, 'N'::character varying,
           (10 + securities.permno)::numeric, 'TR'::character varying,
           (1000 * securities.permno)::numeric
    FROM (VALUES (1), (2), (3), (4), (5), (6), (9), (10), (11)) AS securities(permno)
    JOIN metaexchangecalendar AS calendar
      ON calendar.exchangegroup = 'CIZ' AND calendar.tradingflg = 'Y'
     AND calendar.caldt BETWEEN
         CASE WHEN securities.permno = 10 THEN DATE '2020-02-03' ELSE DATE '2015-06-01' END
